subject: Exec workshop: asset ownership, presenter runway, and deck gating
messages:
From: Caroline Murray <cmurray@straussco.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: anil.gupta@straussco.com, procurement@straussco.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop — alignment on on-site flow and pres/asset owners

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the proposal — leadership at StraussCo confirmed the Oct 19 half-day exec immersion. Two asks before we lock logistics: 1) we need a clear owner list for each on-site segment (who will present and who owns each pre-read), and 2) a minimal "deck gating" checklist so our legal/comms team can sign off on slides before they’re shared with execs.

Can you provide a one-page ownership table and the gating checklist by EOD Monday? Procurement also asked for a short list of attachment types we’ll be sending (slides, bios, MSA redlines).

Caroline
Director, Strategic Partnerships
StraussCo

--
Attachment: RFP_ExecImmersion_Request.pdf (pdf stub)
From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — alignment on on-site flow and pres/asset owners

Caroline — thanks for the clear asks. We can meet those timelines. High level plan:

- Deliverable A: Ownership table (who presents each segment + slide owner + pre-read owner) — deliver by Mon EOD (attached draft).
- Deliverable B: Deck gating checklist (legal/comms sign-off fields, confidentiality flags) — deliver Mon EOD.
- Deliverable C: Attachment manifest for procurement (file types and expected delivery cadence).

Internal owners I’m proposing below. If anyone on this thread objects, please reply with updates; Marcus, Marissa and Priyom I’ve tentatively assigned segments.

Proposed ownership (draft):
- Opening context (10m) — Presenter: Marcus Lin; Slide owner: Marcus; Pre-read owner: Marissa Cole
- Product demo (25m) — Presenter: Priyom Das; Slide owner: Priyom; Pre-read owner: Rachel Kim
- Commercial & ROI (15m) — Presenter: Lauren Bishop; Slide owner: Lauren; Pre-read owner: Marissa Cole
- Q&A / Commitment next steps (10m) — Presenter: Rachel Kim; Slide owner: Rachel; Pre-read owner: Rachel

I’ve attached RW-Exec-Agenda-v0.1.pdf with the slotting. Marcus — can you confirm you and Priyom are comfortable with these slide owners and deliverable dates? Marissa — can you confirm you can assemble the speaker bios sheet and manage the pre-read distribution?

Rachel
Head of Strategic GTM Programs
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel — confirmed. Quick notes:

- Marcus: Opening context — I’ll tighten slides to a 6-slide deck, will drop first draft by Tue morning (Oct 6).
- Priyom: Demo — can you confirm if we’re doing live demo or recorded clip? I think a 2-min clip reduces risk — if live, we need a rehearsal window.
- Marissa: Bios — please use the speaker template we used for Greenleaf and export as xlsx.

Also adding one gating item request for legal: any customer logos or customer stories in slides must have explicit customer consent documented in the gating checklist.
